catalog.title: Generic .NET application test-case catalog
catalog.description: A reusable library of test cases for reviewing .NET applications. Not tied to any application. Pull the relevant ids into a review's own catalog and map them to findings. Categories A-R follow the review methodology in docs/.

appliesTo.framework: ASP.NET Framework 4.x (Web Forms, MVC 5, Web API 2, OWIN)
appliesTo.core: ASP.NET Core 6/8/9 (MVC, Minimal API, Blazor Server)

fields.title: what is being tested
fields.lookFor: the concrete signal a reviewer or rule checks
fields.type: unit | integration | e2e | policy | load | manual

categories.G: Logging, monitoring and sensitive data in logs
categories.I: File upload, download and path traversal
categories.R: Code-quality signals that carry security weight

tests.title: Empty password accepted
tests.lookFor: PrincipalContext.ValidateCredentials or any directory bind without an explicit empty/whitespace guard
tests.expected: empty or whitespace credentials rejected before any directory call

tests.title: Encoded-empty password
tests.lookFor: credentials decoded (base64/URL) after the guard rather than before
tests.expected: guard applied to the DECODED value too

tests.title: LDAP bind without TLS
tests.lookFor: ContextOptions.Negotiate without SecureSocketLayer; LdapConnection without SSL

tests.title: Username enumeration via response or timing
tests.lookFor: different message, status, or code path for unknown user vs wrong password
tests.expected: identical generic response on the same path

tests.title: Unchecked index on identity lookup
tests.lookFor: Entities[0] / First() / [0] on a directory or CRM result with no count check
tests.expected: count checked; unknown user yields the generic failure, not an exception

tests.title: OAuth client authentication not enforced
tests.lookFor: ValidateClientAuthentication calling Validated() unconditionally

tests.title: Excessive access-token lifetime
tests.lookFor: AccessTokenExpireTimeSpan over ~30 minutes, or long JWT exp

tests.title: No refresh token or revocation path
tests.lookFor: no RefreshTokenProvider, no server-side token store, no jti/version deny-list

tests.title: Token still valid after account disable
tests.lookFor: self-contained token never re-validated against the identity store
tests.expected: refresh re-checks the account is enabled

tests.title: JWT algorithm confusion / alg:none
tests.lookFor: TokenValidationParameters not pinning ValidAlgorithms; RS256 vs HS256 acceptance

tests.title: JWT signature or issuer/audience not validated
tests.lookFor: ValidateIssuer/ValidateAudience/ValidateLifetime set false

tests.title: Weak JWT signing secret
tests.lookFor: symmetric key shorter than 256 bits or a literal in config
tests.expected: strong key from a secret store

tests.title: No rate limiting or lockout on login
tests.lookFor: token endpoint with no throttling

tests.title: Session fixation
tests.lookFor: session identifier not regenerated on privilege change
tests.expected: new session id issued after login

tests.title: machineKey absent or shared
tests.lookFor: no <machineKey>, or the same key across environments
tests.expected: explicit per-environment key; tokens survive recycles predictably

tests.title: Data Protection keys not persisted
tests.lookFor: no PersistKeysToFileSystem/AzureBlob in a farm
tests.expected: keys persisted and shared across nodes

tests.title: Password reset token weak or non-expiring
tests.lookFor: predictable token, no expiry, reusable

tests.title: MFA bypassable by skipping a step
tests.lookFor: second factor enforced only in UI flow, not server-side
tests.expected: server enforces completion of every step

tests.title: Endpoint reachable with no authentication
tests.lookFor: controller/action without [Authorize] and no global authorization filter
tests.expected: 401 without a token for every route except the token endpoint

tests.title: No global deny-by-default
tests.lookFor: absence of a globally registered AuthorizeAttribute / FallbackPolicy
tests.expected: default is deny; anonymous is explicit opt-in

tests.title: Horizontal IDOR
tests.lookFor: object id taken from route/body with no ownership comparison against a claim
tests.expected: 403/404 when the object belongs to another user or tenant

tests.title: Vertical privilege escalation
tests.lookFor: role checked in UI but not server-side

tests.title: Role claim derived from an unretrieved field
tests.lookFor: a claim read from an attribute/column absent from the projection or SELECT list
tests.expected: the source field is actually fetched; missing means fail closed

tests.title: Role compared as a loosely-typed string
tests.lookFor: string comparison against "True"/"true" with mismatched casing
tests.expected: parsed boolean or a stable role constant

tests.title: Tenant boundary not enforced in queries
tests.lookFor: repository query lacking a tenant predicate
tests.expected: every query filtered by the caller's tenant

tests.title: Mass assignment / over-posting
tests.lookFor: binding directly to entities; no [Bind] or DTO boundary
tests.expected: server-controlled fields cannot be set by the client

tests.title: Authorization applied at controller but bypassed by a route alias
tests.lookFor: multiple routes reaching one action, only one protected
tests.expected: protection is on the action, not a route

tests.title: AllowAnonymous overrides a protected controller
tests.lookFor: [AllowAnonymous] on an action inside an authorized controller
tests.expected: each occurrence is deliberate and reviewed

tests.title: Authorization depends on network position only
tests.lookFor: comments or design assuming an internal-only host
tests.expected: authorization enforced in the application regardless of network

tests.title: Host-level auth assumed but disabled
tests.lookFor: IIS anonymousAuthentication enabled while the app assumes Windows auth
tests.expected: host configuration matches the application's assumption

tests.title: SQL injection via concatenation
tests.lookFor: string concatenation or interpolation into CommandText/SqlCommand/raw SQL

tests.title: SQL injection via EF raw APIs
tests.lookFor: FromSqlRaw/ExecuteSqlRaw/Database.SqlQuery with interpolated input

tests.title: Injection into an ORDER BY or column name
tests.lookFor: parameterised values but concatenated identifiers

tests.title: Dynamic SQL inside a stored procedure
tests.lookFor: EXEC(@sql) built from parameters

tests.title: LDAP injection
tests.lookFor: user input concatenated into an LDAP filter

tests.title: XPath injection
tests.lookFor: input concatenated into SelectNodes/XPathExpression

tests.title: OS command injection
tests.lookFor: Process.Start / ProcessStartInfo.Arguments built from input
tests.expected: no shell invocation, or strict allow-list arguments

tests.title: Expression/template injection
tests.lookFor: NCalc/DynamicExpresso/Razor/Scriban expression built by string substitution
tests.expected: values bound as parameters, never interpolated

tests.title: NoSQL injection
tests.lookFor: MongoDB filters built from raw JSON strings

tests.title: Denylist validation instead of allow-list
tests.lookFor: regex blocklists of dangerous tokens

tests.title: Validation coverage gap across DTOs
tests.lookFor: public string properties with no validation attribute
tests.expected: every DTO string property validated; measure coverage

tests.title: Validation attribute present but model state ignored
tests.lookFor: no ModelState.IsValid check and no automatic 400 filter

tests.title: Header/CRLF injection
tests.lookFor: user input written into a response header
tests.expected: header value validation (enabled by default in ASP.NET; verify not disabled)

tests.title: Numeric/boundary handling
tests.lookFor: int.Parse on input; no Range attributes

tests.title: Culture-sensitive parsing/formatting of numbers and dates
tests.lookFor: ToString()/Parse without CultureInfo.InvariantCulture on numeric or date values

tests.title: Reflected XSS
tests.lookFor: unencoded input rendered via Html.Raw, @: or Response.Write

tests.title: Stored XSS
tests.lookFor: persisted user content rendered unencoded
tests.expected: encoded on output; sanitised on render, not only input

tests.title: DOM XSS via innerHTML from API data
tests.lookFor: client assigning API values to innerHTML/outerHTML

tests.title: RequestValidation disabled
tests.lookFor: validateRequest=false or [ValidateInput(false)]
tests.expected: kept on, or compensated by explicit encoding

tests.title: MIME sniffing enables HTML rendering of an API response
tests.lookFor: missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff

tests.title: JSON endpoint returns text/html
tests.lookFor: content-type not pinned

tests.title: Open redirect
tests.lookFor: Redirect(returnUrl) without LocalRedirect or allow-list

tests.title: CSRF protection absent on state-changing forms
tests.lookFor: no antiforgery token / [ValidateAntiForgeryToken]
tests.expected: token required on cookie-authenticated state changes

tests.title: Hard-coded credentials in configuration
tests.lookFor: passwords/keys in appSettings, connection strings or source
tests.expected: secret store or protected configuration section

tests.title: Credentials retained in commented-out configuration
tests.lookFor: XML/JSON comments containing key/value credential pairs
tests.expected: removed; history lives in version control

tests.title: Secrets reach the build artifact
tests.lookFor: secrets present in bin/, obj/, or the packaged config

tests.title: Static or zero IV
tests.lookFor: new byte[N] assigned to an IV, or a constant IV

tests.title: Unauthenticated encryption mode
tests.lookFor: CBC/ECB without a MAC

tests.title: ECB mode
tests.lookFor: CipherMode.ECB

tests.title: Insufficient KDF iterations
tests.lookFor: Rfc2898DeriveBytes with a low iteration count

tests.title: Weak hash for passwords
tests.lookFor: MD5/SHA1/unsalted SHA256 for password storage
tests.expected: a password hashing function, not a digest

tests.title: Non-cryptographic randomness for security values
tests.lookFor: System.Random for tokens, ids or keys

tests.title: Encrypt and Decrypt are not inverses
tests.lookFor: differing key derivation or IV handling between the pair

tests.title: Encryption feature flag disabled in production
tests.lookFor: EnableEncryption=false or similar
tests.expected: protection cannot be switched off in Release

tests.title: Secret scanner uses default rules only on .NET
tests.lookFor: CI secret scan without a .NET config ruleset
tests.expected: ruleset covering XML appSettings and connection strings; canary proves it works

tests.title: Certificate validation disabled process-wide
tests.lookFor: ServicePointManager.ServerCertificateValidationCallback returning true

tests.title: Per-handler certificate validation disabled
tests.lookFor: HttpClientHandler.ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback returning true
tests.expected: validation enabled, or a pinned thumbprint

tests.title: SSH host-key verification disabled
tests.lookFor: GiveUpSecurityAndAcceptAnySshHostKey, or an SSH.NET accept-all host-key policy
tests.expected: host key pinned; fail closed on mismatch

tests.title: Obsolete TLS versions permitted
tests.lookFor: SecurityProtocolType.Ssl3/Tls/Tls11

tests.title: No HTTPS redirect or HSTS
tests.lookFor: missing rewrite rule / UseHttpsRedirection / UseHsts

tests.title: Database connection not encrypted
tests.lookFor: connection string without Encrypt=True, or TrustServerCertificate=True

tests.title: Token endpoint allows plaintext HTTP
tests.lookFor: AllowInsecureHttp = true

tests.title: Full request/response bodies logged
tests.lookFor: ReadAsStringAsync result written to a log sink
tests.expected: metadata plus correlation id only, or an allow-list masking projection

tests.title: Log directory inside the webroot
tests.lookFor: Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Logs") or ContentRootPath sinks
tests.expected: log path outside the served root; deny rule as defence in depth

tests.title: Log files served over HTTP
tests.lookFor: GET on the log directory returning content

tests.title: Credentials or tokens written to logs
tests.lookFor: Authorization headers, passwords or tokens in log output

tests.title: Duplicate logging layers
tests.lookFor: message handler, action filter and exception handler all logging bodies

tests.title: No correlation id
tests.lookFor: log entries with no request-scoped identifier

tests.title: No security audit channel
tests.lookFor: auth success/failure, authorization denial and privilege change not logged distinctly
tests.expected: separate audit sink with its own retention

tests.title: Log injection via unescaped input
tests.lookFor: user input concatenated into a log message

tests.title: Log retention not policy-driven
tests.lookFor: arbitrary retainedFileCountLimit
tests.expected: retention matches data-protection policy; encrypted at rest

tests.title: Stack traces returned to clients

tests.title: customErrors / DeveloperExceptionPage in production
tests.lookFor: customErrors mode Off, or UseDeveloperExceptionPage unguarded

tests.title: All errors collapse to 500

tests.title: Absolute server paths disclosed
tests.lookFor: file system paths in responses

tests.title: Framework version headers exposed
tests.lookFor: X-AspNet-Version, X-Powered-By, Server banner

tests.title: API schema exposed without authentication
tests.lookFor: Swagger/OpenAPI registered unconditionally

tests.title: Internal topology in configuration
tests.lookFor: private IPs, internal hostnames, non-standard ports in shipped config

tests.title: Path traversal in file read/write/delete

tests.title: Upload content type not validated

tests.title: XSLT script execution
tests.lookFor: XsltSettings.EnableScript / EnableDocumentFunction

tests.title: ViewState without MAC or encryption
tests.lookFor: EnableViewStateMac=false

tests.title: Untrusted document/spreadsheet parsing

tests.title: Divergent duplicate implementations of one rule

tests.title: Price/amount/quantity tampering

tests.title: Race condition on a limit or balance

tests.title: Rounding and precision errors
tests.lookFor: float/double for money instead of decimal

tests.title: Negative or zero values accepted

tests.title: Discount/coupon stacking

tests.title: Approval threshold enforced client-side only

tests.title: Time-of-check vs time-of-use

tests.title: Downstream failure surfaces as a success

tests.title: Directory browsing enabled

tests.title: Request size limits inconsistent between layers

tests.title: No rate limiting on expensive endpoints

tests.title: Uncatchable failure from unbounded recursion

tests.title: High duplication in security-relevant logic

tests.title: Excessive cognitive complexity in a security path
